note: The one machine-readable list of the ground commands and the bus frames (TFC-IF-004). The C++ (core/include/tfc/protocol.hpp), the Python peers (sim/tfc_peers/protocol.py) and the console are checked against it by sim/tests/test_dictionary.py, so that a command added in one place and not another fails a test. Housekeeping channels and event records (TFC-IF-005, TFC-IF-006) are not here: they are not built.

commands.name: reintegrate
commands.doc: start probation for a latched node: it must then prove itself by shadow vote

commands.name: disable
commands.arm: when it would leave fewer than two healthy nodes
commands.doc: exclude a node for the rest of the run

commands.name: clear-disabled
commands.doc: maintenance: bring a disabled node back to latched with its strikes cleared

commands.name: clear-safe
refused_when: fewer than two nodes are voting
a request is active while the votes are good

commands.name: launch
commands.doc: start the countdown; the sync master acts

commands.name: scrub
commands.doc: back to the pad, before T-zero

commands.name: phase
refused_when: fewer computers vote than the new phase needs

commands.name: noop
commands.doc: changes nothing; answered like any command, to test the path end to end

commands.name: warm
refused_when: the interlock tier of the phase
commands.doc: rest a voting computer as WARM: shadow-voted but not voting; reintegrate promotes it again

frames.name: gyro
frames.doc: id + node: the computer's IMU rates

frames.name: accel
frames.doc: id + node: the IMU's specific force

frames.name: command
frames.doc: id + node: the command and the estimator digest

frames.name: propulsion
frames.doc: id + node: throttle, groups, events, roll, engine count (a mission's computer; not sent by the firmware yet)

frames.name: surface
frames.doc: id + node: four surface deflections (a mission's computer; not sent by the firmware yet)

frames.name: act_output
frames.doc: the voted output and the vote status

frames.name: heartbeat
frames.doc: id + node: version, mode, role, view, reset count, release

frames.name: state_share
frames.doc: id + node: strike counts and the last accepted command counter

frames.name: resync
frames.doc: id + 4 n + chunk: a quarter of the replica's state, in the last frame of each period
